title: OverSire suggestion
description: The only output of an AI job. The user accepts or dismisses it. An accepted proposal becomes a vendor write, a work order or a memory entry. Dates are ISO 8601 UTC.

Proposal.description: What happens on accept. The target is the subject of the suggestion.

relations.description: Relations of the subject to add on accept. Only to items that the job input names. The hub drops none: a cycle fails the accept.

Area.description: A code area tag, for example queue-ui. Lower case.

AreaKind.description: Open set: core (shared code that many items use, for example the contract or a protocol) and feature (one UI page, the docs). A reader that does not know a kind acts as core.

Reason.description: One sentence: why the line helps.

OrderLine.description: Move one entry of a queue lane. The hub applies it to the queue-lanes record.

lane.description: The queue lane id: the store key of the project.

after.description: The entry to move behind. null: the top of the lane.

AreaLine.description: A change to the areas of one item. A line from the real diff names the paths in its reason.

PlannerTrigger.description: A change that made the Planner look again.

kind.description: Open set: itemCreated, queued, itemDone, prMerged, ciFailed, reopened, pathsChanged, heldLong, visionChanged, claimGrown, claimBlocked.

Overlaps.description: The overlap count of the lane: now, and with all lines of the plan change.

PlanDraft.description: A plan change: the proposal of the Planner for one queue lane. The subject of the suggestion is the project. The lines of the proposal, for SuggestionEdit.drop, are in this order: each order line, each relations line, then each areas line.

kinds.description: The kind of each area in the areas lines that the area catalog does not have. On accept, the hub adds these areas to the catalog.

SuggestionEdit.description: What the user removed before Accept. The user can only remove lines, never add text. Only a plan proposal takes an edit.

drop.description: The indexes of the proposal lines to drop.

kind.description: The Job kind. Open set: triage, failureReason, digest, changeSummary, tidy, memoryUpkeep, plan.

proposal.description: Missing: the suggestion only informs. Accept then sets it to done. A reader that does not know the proposal type keeps it as it is. Schema 1 had the type sequence. A schema 2 reader keeps it as an unknown type. The hub does not write it.

edit.description: Set with state accepted. On accept, the hub drops these lines from the proposal, saves the edited proposal and removes the edit.

dedupeKey.description: Subject, kind and subject version. A job does not write a second open suggestion with the same key.

subjectVersion.description: The vendor version of the subject, for example its updatedAt or head SHA. An open plan change keeps its id and gets a new subjectVersion when a new trigger updates it.

decidedBy.description: The device id that accepted or dismissed.

jobRun.description: The JobRun id that wrote the suggestion.
